protagonist.ren.name: Ren Takahashi
protagonist.ren.tagline: A 27-year-old office worker, hit by a truck. It happens.
skill.common.slash.name: Slash
skill.common.slash.desc: A sword strike in an arc in front of you.
skill.ren.analyze.name: Analyze
skill.ren.analyze.desc: Observe a target to reveal its stats and weaknesses.

enemy.slime_ember.name: Ember slime
item.frost_pelt.name: Frost pelt
item.frost_pelt.desc: Thick white fur that never quite warms up.
item.ember_core.name: Ember core
item.ember_core.desc: A glowing lump that is warm to the touch. Smiths love it.
enemy.gel_king.name: Gel King
item.gel_mail.name: Gel mail
item.gel_mail.desc: Plates of hardened gel. Cold, light and surprisingly tough.
quest.cellar.name: The Mossveil Cellar
quest.cellar.kill: Defeat the Gel King in Mossveil Cellar, north-east of where you woke up.
quest.cellar.report: Report to Mira at the guild.
enemy.barrow_warden.name: Barrow Warden
item.warden_blade.name: Warden's blade
item.warden_blade.desc: A black blade that hums in the hand. It cut through a hundred years of silence.
quest.barrow.name: The Barrow Warden
quest.barrow.kill: Defeat the Warden in Grunmoor Barrow, north-west of where you woke up.
quest.barrow.report: Report to Mira at the guild.
enemy.slime_blue.name: Blue slime
enemy.wolf_grey.name: Grey wolf
item.wolf_fang.name: Wolf fang
item.wolf_fang.desc: Sharp and yellowed. Hunters and smiths pay for it.
quest.slime_extermination.name: Slime extermination
quest.slime_extermination.kill: Defeat 5 green slimes on the plains.
quest.slime_extermination.report: Report to Mira at the guild.
dlg.ren.prologue.n1: Welcome, Guest. Your old world has let you go.
dlg.ren.prologue.n4: Let's say the truck played a part.

item.potion_small.name: {count, plural, one {Small potion} other {Small potions}}
item.potion_small.desc: Restores a good deal of health.
item.iron_sword.name: Iron sword
item.iron_sword.desc: A solid blade, sharper than a practice sword.
item.steel_sword.name: Steel sword
item.steel_sword.desc: Well balanced and keen. A real adventurer's sword.
item.leather_vest.name: Leather vest
item.chain_mail.name: Chain mail
item.chain_mail.desc: Heavy rings that turn a blade aside.
enemy.slime_slate.name: Slate slime
item.slate_shard.name: Slate shard
item.slate_shard.desc: A flat grey chip, hard as the mountain it came from.
enemy.wolf_shade.name: Shade wolf
item.shade_wisp.name: Shade wisp
item.shade_wisp.desc: A thread of violet mist that stays cold in the hand.
enemy.slime_tide.name: Tide slime
item.tide_pearl.name: Tide pearl
item.tide_pearl.desc: A small salty pearl. Sailors say it brings a calm sea.
enemy.slime_glow.name: Glow slime
item.star_dust.name: Star dust
item.star_dust.desc: A pinch of light that sparkles even in a closed pouch. Scholars pay well for it.
enemy.iron_foreman.name: Ironbound Foreman
item.foreman_maul.name: Foreman's maul
item.foreman_maul.desc: A heavy maul that rings like a bell. It still remembers the mine.
quest.mine.name: The Ironspine Mine
quest.mine.kill: Defeat the Ironbound Foreman in the sealed mine of Ironspine, far north-east beyond the mountains.
quest.mine.report: Report to Mira at the guild.
enemy.tide_regent.name: Tide Regent
item.tidescale_mail.name: Tidescale mail
item.tidescale_mail.desc: Scales of a drowned king, cold and light as the sea.
quest.temple.name: The Drowned Temple
quest.temple.kill: Defeat the Tide Regent in the Drowned Temple on the coast of Tidehaven, far south-west.
quest.temple.report: Report to Mira at the guild.
enemy.rime_revenant.name: Rime Revenant
item.rimeblade.name: Rimeblade
item.rimeblade.desc: A sword of living ice that never melts, however warm the hand.
quest.cavern.name: The Frostveil Cavern
quest.cavern.kill: Defeat the Rime Revenant in the Frostveil Cavern, far to the north beyond the plains.
quest.cavern.report: Report to Mira at the guild.
enemy.moonshade_alpha.name: Moonshade Alpha
item.shadehide_cloak.name: Shadehide cloak
item.shadehide_cloak.desc: Silver-black fur that drinks the light and gives back only quiet.
quest.hollow.name: The Whisperwood Hollow
quest.hollow.kill: Defeat the Moonshade Alpha in the Whisperwood Hollow, deep in the forest to the north-west.
quest.hollow.report: Report to Mira at the guild.
enemy.sand_sentinel.name: Sand Sentinel
item.sunbrand.name: Sunbrand
item.sunbrand.desc: A blade of gold the desert sun has been polishing for a thousand years.
quest.ziggurat.name: The Sunken Ziggurat
quest.ziggurat.kill: Defeat the Sand Sentinel in the Sunken Ziggurat of Sunscar, far to the south-east.
quest.ziggurat.report: Report to Mira at the guild.
enemy.astral_curator.name: Astral Curator
item.starweave_robe.name: Starweave robe
item.starweave_robe.desc: Cloth spun from starlight; it hums softly when spells come near.
quest.observatory.name: The Starfall Observatory
quest.observatory.kill: Defeat the Astral Curator in the Starfall Observatory of Lumeria, far to the south.
quest.observatory.report: Report to Mira at the guild.
enemy.cinder_colossus.name: Cinder Colossus
item.cinderblade.name: Cinderblade
item.cinderblade.desc: Black glass still warm from the forge that made it, and still hungry.
quest.citadel.name: The Cinder Citadel
quest.citadel.kill: Defeat the Cinder Colossus in the Cinder Citadel, far east in the Ashen Wastes.
quest.citadel.report: Report to Mira at the guild.
quest.meadow_gel.name: Gel on the Meadow
quest.meadow_gel.hunt: Hunt the green slimes on the meadows and bring back gel for the cooper.
quest.lantern_wisps.name: Wisps for the Lanterns
quest.lantern_wisps.hunt: Hunt the shade wolves of the Whisperwood and bring back their wisps for the lanterns of the village.
quest.slate_toll.name: The Slate Toll
quest.slate_toll.hunt: Clear the slate slimes from the roads of Ironspine and bring back slate shards for the smith.
quest.garden_gel.name: Gel for the Garden
quest.garden_gel.hunt: Drive off the sand slimes trampling the terraces of Sunscar and gather gel for the roots.
quest.winter_pelts.name: Pelts for the Winter
quest.winter_pelts.hunt: Hunt the frost wolves of Frostveil and bring back their pelts before the deep winter.
quest.tide_pearls.name: Pearls from the Tide
quest.tide_pearls.hunt: Clear the tide slimes from the shallows of Tidehaven and bring back five pearls.
quest.furnace_cores.name: Cores for the Furnace
quest.furnace_cores.hunt: Hunt the ember slimes of the Ashen Wastes and bring back their cores for the furnace.
quest.dust_survey.name: The Star Dust Survey
quest.dust_survey.hunt: Cull the glow slimes of Lumeria and gather five measures of star dust for the Archive.
enemy.wolf_dire.name: Dire wolf
item.dire_fang.name: Dire fang
item.dire_fang.desc: A fang as long as a finger, yellow and heavy.
enemy.slime_magma.name: Magma slime
item.magma_shard.name: Magma shard
item.magma_shard.desc: Black glass that still glows at the edge, and never quite cools.
enemy.slime_amber.name: Amber slime
item.amber_drop.name: Amber drop
item.amber_drop.desc: A drop of old sun-colored resin, with a very small fly inside.
enemy.wolf_storm.name: Storm wolf
item.storm_feather.name: Storm feather
item.storm_feather.desc: No bird wore it. It crackles when you stroke it the wrong way.
enemy.slime_coral.name: Coral slime
item.coral_fragment.name: Coral fragment
item.coral_fragment.desc: Pink and branching, still smelling of the reef.
enemy.slime_ice.name: Ice slime
item.ice_crystal.name: Ice crystal
item.potion_medium.name: Medium potion
item.potion_medium.desc: Heals a good deal of health.
item.potion_large.name: Large potion
item.potion_large.desc: A flask for the end of a long road.
item.grilled_fish.name: Grilled fish
item.grilled_fish.desc: Salt, smoke and a little lemon.
item.honey_cake.name: Honey cake
item.honey_cake.desc: Sticky, golden and gone in three bites.
item.hearty_stew.name: Hearty stew
item.hearty_stew.desc: Stays with you for a whole afternoon.
item.knight_sword.name: Knight's sword
item.runed_blade.name: Runed blade
item.brigandine.name: Brigandine
item.brigandine.desc: Small plates sewn inside good cloth.
item.plate_cuirass.name: Plate cuirass
item.plate_cuirass.desc: Heavy, loud and very difficult to argue with.
item.mage_robe.name: Mage's robe
item.mage_robe.desc: Thin cloth that turns spells better than blades.
quest.pantry_fangs.name: Fangs for the Taproom
quest.pantry_fangs.bring: Bring four wolf fangs to hang over the taproom door.
quest.pantry_dire.name: A Fang for the Hearth
quest.pantry_dire.bring: Bring three dire fangs from the wolves of the deep forest.
quest.pantry_bar.name: A Bar Top of Slate
quest.pantry_bar.bring: Bring ten slate shards for a new bar top.
quest.pantry_amber.name: Amber for the Window
quest.pantry_amber.bring: Bring five drops of amber for the window of the inn.
quest.pantry_ice.name: Ice for the Cellar
quest.pantry_ice.bring: Bring four ice crystals for the cold cellar.
quest.pantry_coral.name: Coral for the Sign
quest.pantry_coral.bring: Bring five coral fragments for a new inn sign.
quest.pantry_magma.name: Embers for the Hearth
quest.pantry_magma.bring: Bring three magma shards to keep the hearth lit.
quest.pantry_feathers.name: Feathers for the Lamp
quest.pantry_feathers.bring: Bring three storm feathers for the inn lamp.
item.fang_dagger.name: Fang dagger
item.fang_dagger.desc: Eight fangs and a good deal of glue, and it still cuts clean.
item.wisp_mantle.name: Wisp mantle
item.wisp_mantle.desc: It is cold to hold and warm to wear, which nobody can explain.
item.slate_cleaver.name: Slate cleaver
item.slate_cleaver.desc: One flat edge, no ornament. It does not need any.
item.amber_plate.name: Amber plate
item.amber_plate.desc: Honey-colored and surprisingly sturdy; a few flies are still inside.
item.frostfur_coat.name: Frostfur coat
item.frostfur_coat.desc: Heavy fur sewn with ice that never melts. Warmer than it sounds.
item.pearl_rapier.name: Pearl rapier
item.pearl_rapier.desc: A pearl on the guard and a thin, quick blade.
item.ember_greatsword.name: Ember greatsword
item.ember_greatsword.desc: Too hot to leave in a scabbard for long.
item.starlit_vestment.name: Starlit vestment
item.starlit_vestment.desc: The Archive classifies it as a robe. The robe disagrees.
item.alpha_pelt.name: Alpha's pelt
item.alpha_pelt.desc: Thick, dark and still faintly growling.
enemy.dire_alpha.name: Dire Alpha
item.heartfire_blade.name: Heartfire blade
item.heartfire_blade.desc: It beats, very slowly, in the hand.
enemy.magma_heart.name: Magma Heart
item.coralweave_vest.name: Coralweave vest
item.coralweave_vest.desc: Woven by something patient, in the dark, for a very long time.
enemy.coral_matron.name: Coral Matron
item.queens_stinger.name: Queen's stinger
item.queens_stinger.desc: A long amber spike. It hums if you hold it near honey.
enemy.amber_queen.name: Amber Queen
item.glacier_plate.name: Glacier plate
item.glacier_plate.desc: Layers of old ice, hard as iron and never wet.
enemy.ice_warden.name: Ice Warden
item.thunderfang.name: Thunderfang
item.thunderfang.desc: You hear it before you see it.
enemy.storm_sovereign.name: Storm Sovereign
quest.crowned_one.name: The Crowned One
quest.crowned_one.hunt: Defeat the Gel King in the flooded cellar north-east of the village.
quest.silver_alpha.name: The Silver Alpha
quest.silver_alpha.hunt: Defeat the Moonshade Alpha in the ring of trees deep in the Whisperwood.
quest.den_alpha.name: The Alpha of the Den
quest.den_alpha.hunt: Defeat the Dire Alpha in the Dire Den in the foothills of Ironspine.
quest.amber_queen_hunt.name: The Amber Queen
quest.amber_queen_hunt.hunt: Defeat the Amber Queen in the Amber Hollow in the dunes of Sunscar.
quest.pit_warden.name: The Warden of the Pit
quest.pit_warden.hunt: Defeat the Ice Warden in the Ice Pit in the glaciers of Frostveil.
quest.grotto_matron.name: The Matron of the Grotto
quest.grotto_matron.hunt: Defeat the Coral Matron in the Coral Grotto on the coast of Tidehaven.
quest.vent_heart.name: The Heart of the Vent
quest.vent_heart.hunt: Defeat the Magma Heart in the Magma Vent in the Ashen Wastes.
quest.roost_sovereign.name: The Sovereign of the Roost
quest.roost_sovereign.hunt: Defeat the Storm Sovereign in the Storm Roost on the plains of Lumeria.
enemy.forge_tyrant.name: Forge Tyrant
item.tyrants_hammer.name: Tyrant's hammer
item.tyrants_hammer.desc: It was made to hammer a mountain. It will do for a skull.
quest.forge.name: The Deep Forge
quest.forge.kill: Defeat the Forge Tyrant in the Deep Forge under Ironspine, far to the north-east.
quest.forge.report: Report to Mira at the guild.
enemy.drowned_captain.name: Drowned Captain
item.captains_cutlass.name: Captain's cutlass
item.captains_cutlass.desc: Still salt-wet after a hundred years under the bay.
quest.galleon.name: The Sunken Galleon
quest.galleon.kill: Defeat the Drowned Captain in the Sunken Galleon, far south-west along the coast of Tidehaven.
quest.galleon.report: Report to Mira at the guild.
enemy.frost_sovereign.name: Frost Sovereign
item.sovereigns_mantle.name: Sovereign's mantle
item.sovereigns_mantle.desc: Ermine and ice. It does not melt, and it does not forget.
quest.keep.name: The Glacier Keep
quest.keep.kill: Defeat the Frost Sovereign in the Glacier Keep, far north in Frostveil.
quest.keep.report: Report to Mira at the guild.
enemy.vault_warden.name: Vault Warden
item.obsidian_edge.name: Obsidian edge
item.obsidian_edge.desc: Black glass honed to nothing. It cuts the light first.
quest.vault.name: The Obsidian Vault
quest.vault.kill: Defeat the Vault Warden in the Obsidian Vault, deep in the Ashen Wastes.
quest.vault.report: Report to Mira at the guild.
